Subject: Next steps: procurement checklist, payment path & marketplace question

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary (very short)
- GreenLeaf is excited to pilot Redwood for a customer-facing summarization feature.
- Primary procurement preference: you indicated PO for enterprise deals; card is possible for small pilot spend.
- Marketplace: you asked whether Redwood can appear in CloudMarket; we said yes but that requires some extra paperwork.

Immediate asks from GreenLeaf (what we need to move forward)
1) Completed procurement intake form (attached) — includes legal name, W-9/W-8, banking contact.
2) Confirmation of preferred payment path (PO with Net30 or card).
3) If marketplace interest, a short note of the decision by EOD next week so we can size the onboarding work.

I attached a procurement_intake_form.xlsx and a sample supplier packet for reference. If you already have a W-9 and bank remittance PDF, please send those as attachments and we can kick off vendor setup with finance.

Proposed mutual action plan:
- Tue (Nov 24): GreenLeaf returns intake form + W-9/banking stub.
- Wed (Nov 25): Redwood sends DocuSign for standard SOW/PO instructions (if PO path).
- Next week: Marissa will confirm billing contact for invoicing and finance onboarding.

If anything above doesn't match your understanding, call it out. Otherwise, send the intake docs and we'll route to onboarding.

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear recap. Attaching the W-9 and a PDF with our banking contact. A few clarifications from our side:

- We prefer PO / Net30 for anything above $5k. For pilots under $5k we can pay by card.
- We're interested in marketplace exposure (CloudMarket) but need to understand any additional fees or contract language — want to confirm internally.
- You mentioned W-8 vs W-9 on the call — we are a US entity and will provide the W-9 (attached).

Attachments included:
- W-9_GreenLeaf.pdf
- Vendor_Banking_Details.pdf

Next step: I will try to get the signed procurement intake form back by Monday but attaching the two docs now so you can start finance intake.

—Laura
